notes: The multinomial model has time as its only predictor, so unadjusted is true and confounders null. Lineages under 1% are aggregated to parents (quantization) and variant-attributed cases are arithmetic, so neither is a procedure. NREVSS feeds only survey weights after May 2023, so it is named but not typed; setting could also be read as US national.
